Nyborg is a Danish municipality included in the clinical quality benchmarking of the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates the quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities to aid local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. 

Specifically, Nyborg's data is utilized in the calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation (AK) treatment using data from the DanStroke registry [^src1]. The municipality's specific statistical performance regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is recorded in the municipal breakdown on page 94 of the report [^src1]. Because the provided text is strictly a statistical registry excerpt, no further relationships, specific qualitative claims, or historical timeline events are documented for Nyborg beyond its inclusion in this dataset.
